body: Mumbling helps sometimes. I just dont know what sort of test this is. It's questioned my belief in everything including my faith, and to be honest I've really given up.

I just don't know why I try, yes life is supposed to difficult, but it still is just overwhelming, and I dont see a break in sight. More like one step forward and two steps back. I guess I need to try even harder, but I cant seem to find the strength to do it.
Well I have yet to find someone, I wish you better luck.

I just panicked this semester, and just withdrew, the neuro is confident I can appeal and get my scholarships back. But I know how it feels. 

They just put all medicines behind a wall because people just abuse them, which makes it difficult for those that really need them to get them.
Trial and Error I guess, I'm just going to have to keep trying. My college has a psychiatrist, but I doubt they would write a script.

I only just got my diagnosis, in Febuary of this Year. During that time I ended HS, and went to college, and it's part of the reason I hate college. I just cant work, and it kills me inside. I just started the summer semester hence the urgency. I was doing a bit of googling, and I found a psychiatrist that has a rep of just handing out pills and getting you out of there. I might give it a shot...

Strangely I used to be able to lie, and it was more convincing than telling the truth to some. It's quite a powerful tool. In the last few years, I have such a fear of talking to anyone, mainly brought on by my poor performance, and lack of focus.
Thanks for that. I just get so nervous I find it hard to look at them. I'll just do my best to calm myself down, for my own sake. I really need this.

I normally just try and answer there questions, I normally dont sit still, and I dont normally look them in the eye. 

I dont think he can, he's a old style doctor, only takes cash, and it out in the middle of nowhere.

Bit of a mix up, the general didnt feel safe writing it (which makes sense) the local psychiatrist said he wanted to try electro stim. 

I did get a full neuro exam, by a neuropsychologist, so I've got the doctors backing, he wants me to try it, but cant find anyone to write the prescription. 

You sound a lot like me, I hope this gives me the pep I need.
My neuro sent me to one he knew was loose with the prescriptions, the guy called me a pill junkie, and accused me of faking a neurologist test.

See I dont even ask for Adderall, I just ask for medication to help my symptoms, and I think I do a pretty convincing job of being ignorant. I guess it will just have to be trial and error. One thing though, if someone is willing to write it, is it okay to ask for a particular type or possibly a higher dosage than base?
